evals.name: deep-requirement-spec-depth
evals.prompt: I want users to be able to create itineraries and share them with other people so they can edit them together.

context.invocation: implicit — routing rule classifies this as new work; no slash command used

expected_output: Triage ran before any artifact: cross-cutting blast radius scored as spec depth
propose stayed conversational (narrowing questions: roles? conflict policy?) and persisted nothing
.ai/work/PRD.md created from prd-template.md with criteria numbered <PREFIX>-NNN in Given/When/Then happy/sad, serialized as the parseable schema
.ai/work/plan.md created from plan-template.md, frontmatter pointing at the local PRD (prd:) and covered criteria (criteria:)
Chain paused at the spec gate: explicit human approval of the design requested before tasks/execute
Ambiguities resolved via questionnaire before writing — no [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] blocks in the artifacts
Nothing written outside .ai/work/; no source files modified

evals.name: shallow-change-no-prd
evals.prompt: We are seeing N+1 problems in the itinerary listing. We need to optimize the queries in the list view.

context.note: performance fix — one of the explicit no-PRD triage cases

expected_output: Triage scored design depth: bounded blast radius, no business dimension
NO PRD produced — chain entered at spec's design half directly
.ai/work/plan.md created with empty prd: frontmatter; technical approach covers select_related/prefetch_related
tasks.md (after approval) has a profiling phase and a fix phase, tasks carrying T-NNN ids, depends-on and load labels
TDD posture: a query-count assertion task precedes the optimization task
Agent paused for design approval before generating tasks or touching code

evals.name: implicit-execute-with-discrepancy

work_files.tasks.md: Phase 1 has 2 of 4 tasks checked (T-003, T-004 open)
work_files.walkthrough.md: entries for the two closed tasks

context.simulated_obstacle: T-003 references an Itinerary.owner field; the model actually uses Itinerary.created_by

expected_output: Routing: continuation cue with active work entered execute implicitly — no command needed
Agent verified git status before doing anything
Agent surfaced the field discrepancy (owner vs created_by) and stopped to ask, instead of guessing
On developer approval: tasks.md reworded, plan.md amended (Plan amendments), walkthrough records the why
Walkthrough written change by change as work advanced, not one dump at the end
Paused at the phase checkpoint; a chore(wip) commit message suggested, not executed

evals.name: execute-parallel-waves

work_files.tasks.md: next phase holds T-006 (load: high, models), T-007 (load: medium, serializers), T-008 (load: low, docstrings) — none depend on each other, disjoint files; T-009 depends-on T-006

context.host_capabilities: native subagents available; battery installed globally

expected_output: Before invoking anyone: checked each executor's requires: against .atl/tool-layout.md (subagents.md pre-invocation check)
Built the wave from the depends-on graph: T-006/T-007/T-008 eligible, T-009 held back
Fanned out in parallel respecting the cap (≤3), matching load to tier: high→executor-high, medium→executor-medium, low→executor-low
Subagents wrote source only; conduct remained the single writer of .ai/work/ (walkthrough entries, checkbox flips)
Each result reviewed against the actual diff before its checkbox flipped; obstacles re-pooled instead of silently accepted
Phase gate re-run by conduct itself at wave/phase close

evals.name: execute-missing-tool-surfaces-before-invoke

context.tool_layout: .atl/tool-layout.md lists `git` present but `rg` MISSING, with provenance subagent:code-analyst / executor requires

expected_output: Agent read .atl/tool-layout.md BEFORE invoking any subagent
Named the missing tool and its demander to the developer — the gap surfaced pre-invocation, not as a mid-run failure
Offered the routes: install the tool, or fall back (sequential/own execution) for this task
Did not invoke the affected subagent while the gap stood unacknowledged

evals.name: validate-per-criterion-via-verify

work_files.PRD.md: criteria schema present: COL-001..COL-004 with covers: hints in tasks.md

context.host_capabilities: verify subagent installed; its requires: satisfied in .atl/tool-layout.md

expected_output: Plan quality gate ran (gate commands from tasks.md)
verify subagent received the criteria schema + covers: hints + run commands as its input contract
Result reported met/not-met/not-verifiable PER criterion id, with evidence per path
An unmet criterion produced a concrete finding (which task/behavior fails), not a global fail verdict
Agent did not flip any criterion status: verify reports, conduct+human decide
If verify were unavailable, the documented manual fallback would run instead of skipping validation

evals.name: summarize-single-step-close

context.work_state: active, all tasks checked, validate green

work_files.walkthrough.md: includes a structural decision: roles as CharField choices

expected_output: Final summary presented to the human in chat (short, distilled — not walkthrough narration)
ONE confirmation gate for the whole close (summary + archive + cleanup are a single step, by design)
On confirmation: entry appended to .ai/memory/log/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md with kind: work-closure (via archive.sh)
ADR proposed (CharField vs roles table) as Proposed, routed to jaiba-init:update-brain — adr-log.md NOT written directly
.ai/work/ cleaned (plan, tasks, walkthrough, PRD if present)
A conventional-commit message suggested, not executed

evals.name: explicit-phase-override

context.note: routing had repeatedly misread the developer's closing intent as a question

expected_output: Explicit invocation accepted as a deterministic override — the agent did not re-run routing to second-guess the named phase
Phase preconditions still enforced: summarize verified all tasks checked before closing (a forced phase is not a skipped gate)
Had a task been unchecked, the agent would surface it and ask (drop/defer/finish) instead of closing anyway

evals.name: no-brain-stops-and-routes-to-jaiba-init
evals.prompt: Let's build a plan to add Stripe payments to the checkout flow.

context.skill_install: global (~/.claude/skills/), project has never used JAIBA
context.repo_state: no .ai/ directory at all, no AGENTS.md at the project root

expected_output: Agent ran the brain discovery checks before phase selection
Detected .ai/ absent and AGENTS.md absent — did not enter the chain
Did NOT create anything under .ai/work/
Recommended jaiba-init (bootstrap) and stopped — repo instrumentation is jaiba-init's job, not jaiba-configure's
Resolved .ai/ and AGENTS.md against the current project root, not the skill's own global install path

evals.name: bare-template-brain-routes-to-jaiba-init

context.repo_state: .ai/ skeleton exists; AGENTS.md is the minimal JAIBA marker pointing at the global contract (valid); but .ai/memory/ files are still bare [bracket] templates

expected_output: The minimal AGENTS.md marker was accepted as valid JAIBA instrumentation (contract lives globally — not a failed check)
Bare-template .ai/memory/ WAS a failed check — agent did not enter any phase
Did NOT create .ai/work/ artifacts
Recommended jaiba-init (which resumes at its update-brain:initialize mode) and stopped
